description: Shared contracts + API for the recipient album. Adds TripRecapPhotosDTO and tripRecapPhotosQuerySchema to @dwt/shared (and rebuilds dist for the api), extracts the gate into sharing/tripRecapAccess.ts shared by both routes, adds GET /me/inbox/:shareId/trip-recap/photos beside the recap route, adds RecapPhotoPort.albumPage/isAlbumPhoto (serving keys only, keyset pagination, block filter), and widens PhotoService.report/addBlock from 'current highlight' to 'approved trip photo of the share's trip' keeping D31. Depends on FEAT-001 for requirement ids. FEAT-003 depends on this one.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/photo-uploads/recap-album-plan.md sections 1, 2, 4 and 5 in full before editing.

packages/shared: add TripRecapPhotosDTO (src/dto/Photos.ts) and tripRecapPhotosQuerySchema (src/schemas/Photos.ts); export both by name from src/dto/index.ts, src/schemas/index.ts and src/index.ts; add schema tests (valid and invalid cases) in src/__tests__/photos.test.ts and a DTO key-set test in src/__tests__/contracts.phase2.test.ts. Then run `npm run build:shared` from the repo root so apps/api sees the new exports.
apps/api/src/services/sharing/ports.ts: add RecapAlbumPage and the albumPage/isAlbumPhoto members to RecapPhotoPort (keep highlights/isHighlight).

apps/api/src/services/sharing/tripRecapAccess.ts (new): resolveShareAccess and photoAccessFor. Refactor the existing recap handler in tripRecapRoutes.ts to use them with IDENTICAL behavior and order; do not change its existing tests except the flagged ones below.

apps/api/src/services/sharing/tripRecapRoutes.ts: register GET /me/inbox/:shareId/trip-recap/photos inside registerTripRecapRoutes (params uuid, query via tripRecapPhotosQuerySchema, resolveShareAccess, Cache-Control private no-store, photoAccessFor, port.albumPage with default limit 40; never read tripShareFacts.summary). Keep the file free of imports from trips/repo, trips/authz, db/pool and pg.

apps/api/src/services/photos/recapPhotoPort.ts: implement albumPage (no query when !tripAvailable or !includePhotos; decodeAlbumCursor, malformed -> AppError validation_failed; explicit columns p.id, p.sort_at, p.width, p.height; target_kind='trip' AND target_id=$1 AND status='approved'; user_blocks NOT EXISTS either way; ORDER BY sort_at DESC, id DESC; keyset OR predicate; LIMIT limit+1; URLs from photoKeys(id) only; items built with exactly the six literal keys; nextCursor via encodeAlbumCursor) and isAlbumPhoto.

apps/api/src/services/photos/service.ts: change the structural recapPhotoPort option type and field to { isAlbumPhoto(...) } and switch report() and addBlock() from isHighlight to isAlbumPhoto (message 'Photo is not available through this share'). Leave every other check as is.

Forced edits to existing tests: add albumPage/isAlbumPhoto stubs to fakePhotoPort in tripRecapRoutes.test.ts; change the literal in reportsRepo.test.ts to { isAlbumPhoto }; in the 'report and block through shareId' test change step 2 (approved non-highlight photo with shareId) from 404 to 204; add 'GET /me/inbox/:shareId/trip-recap/photos' to the expected list in noRevoke.test.ts; grep for any other hand-built RecapPhotoPort and fix it.

New tests per plan section 5 rows 1-22: tripRecapAlbumRoutes.test.ts (server.inject + pg-mem; gate matrix exhaustive loop tagged Property 44; contents/statuses/blocks; 9-photo vs 3-highlight case; pagination bounds; exact key sets and sentinel no-leak; serving keys with FakeObjectStore.missingGetKeys(); cache header; log capture; kill switch and production registration with photos on and off; widened report/block incl. negatives and D31), tripRecapAccess.test.ts, photos/__tests__/recapPhotoPort.test.ts, photos/__tests__/recapAlbum.prop.test.ts (fast-check numRuns 100, tagged Property 45). Seed rows must satisfy the migration 0062 CHECKs (distinct object_key/thumb_key, approved needs harm_verdict 'pass' and etags, rejected needs reject_reason).

Inner loop while editing: `npx vitest run <file>` in apps/api or packages/shared, plus `npm run typecheck` after type changes (after `npm run build:shared`). When the area is done run `npm run verify:shared` and `npm run verify:api` once each; do NOT run the full `npm run verify` here.
Do not commit or push. Set this feature's status to completed in this file and record in findings: the list of files changed, the exact export names added, and anything not verified.
acceptance_criteria: GET /me/inbox/:shareId/trip-recap/photos returns 401 without a session, the collapsed validation_failed for a non-recipient / deleted share / unfriended recipient with zero Trip or photo reads after a failed Friend check, 200 unavailable when the sharer left, the Trip is gone or PHOTOS_ENABLED=false, and 200 not_included when includePhotos is false

A granted response lists every approved, not-blocked photo of the share's Trip ordered by sort_at desc then id desc, each photo has exactly the keys id, thumbUrl, url, width, height, sortAt, the body has exactly access, photos, nextCursor, and no uploader identity, caption, feed item id, object key or bucket name appears in the serialized body
Paging with nextCursor returns each eligible photo exactly once (fast-check, >= 100 runs); limit bounds 1..100 default 40 and bad query/cursor answer validation_failed
Every minted URL key is p/<id>/full.jpg or p/<id>/thumb.jpg and exists in a store seeded with only p/ objects; Cache-Control is private, no-store; nothing URL-like is logged

POST /photos/:id/report and POST /me/blocks with a valid shareId accept any approved trip photo of that share's Trip (not blocked, not own) and answer photo_not_found for other-trip, non-approved, blocked, own, includePhotos=false and unfriended cases with nothing recorded; a recipient report is recorded but does not hide the photo (D31)
The recap route's behavior and existing tests are unchanged apart from the flagged fake and the flagged report step; noRevoke.test.ts passes with the new route in its allowlist
npm run verify:shared and npm run verify:api exit 0
verification: npx vitest run src/services/sharing src/services/photos (from apps/api)
